---
title: "Plotting MAVE Flow-Seq Scores for MDSGene Annotated Variants"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Overview
This analysis investigates the MAVE flow-seq scores for GBA1 variants annotated by MDSGene

Analysis included are shown in figure 3, supplementary figure 9 and 10

```{r packages}

library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggalluvial)
library(patchwork)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(rstatix)
```

# Load raw data

```{r load-data}
MasterFile_Input <- readxl::read_excel("Supplementary Table 2_MAVE Master File.xlsx")
```


# Stop Codon Score Calculation
Calculate the average stop codon score of GBA1 variants from the MAVE flow-seq dataset

```{r Stop-codon Calculation}
GBAAnalysisStopCodon <- MasterFile_Input %>%
  mutate(Position = as.numeric(Position)) %>%
  filter(
    WT_AA != Mutant_AA,
    Mutant_AA == "*",
    !is.na(MAVE_Score),
    Position > 20
  )

stop_median <- median(
  GBAAnalysisStopCodon$MAVE_Score,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

```

# Prepare MDSGene data for plotting
Filter data for MDSGene missense and nonsense variants
Collect MDSGene annotated variants
Add MAVE barcode information

```{r Prepare data}
MDS_MissenseNonsense_Subset <- MasterFile_Input %>%
  filter(!is.na(MDSGene_Genetic_Classification)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(MAVE_Score)) %>%
  mutate(MDSGene_Genetic_Classification = factor(MDSGene_Genetic_Classification, 
                                                 levels = c("Pathogenic", 
                                                            "Likely Pathogenic",
                                                            "Benign", 
                                                            "Likely Benign", 
                                                            "VUS"))) %>%
  mutate(MDSGene_Clinical_Severity = factor(MDSGene_Clinical_Severity, levels = c("Severe", 
                                                                                  "Severe (Null)",
                                                                                  "Mild", 
                                                                                  "PD Risk Variant", 
                                                                                  "Unknown", 
                                                                                  "Not Reported"))) 
  

MDS_MissenseNonsense_Subset <- MDS_MissenseNonsense_Subset %>%
  mutate(
    Barcode_Group = ifelse(
      MAVE_Barcode_Count >= 3,
      "≥3 barcodes",
      "<3 barcodes"
    )
  )
```

#Generate Summary Files of MAVE Flow-seq Scores for MDSGene Annotations: Genetic Classification and Clinical Severity

```{r data-processing}
MDSVariantSummary_GeneticClassification <- MDS_MissenseNonsense_Subset %>%
  filter(!is.na(MAVE_Score)) %>%
  group_by(MDSGene_Genetic_Classification) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),  
    mean_score = mean(MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_score = min(MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_score = max(MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_score = sd(MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    median = quantile(MAVE_Score, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1 = quantile(MAVE_Score, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3 = quantile(MAVE_Score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr = IQR(MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    Significant = sum(MAVE_Empirical_p_Value <= 0.05 & MAVE_Barcode_Count >= 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    Percent_Significant = ((Significant/ n ) * 100),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

MDSVariantSummary_ClinicalSeverity <- MDS_MissenseNonsense_Subset %>%
  filter(!is.na(MAVE_Score)) %>%
  group_by(MDSGene_Clinical_Severity) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(), 
    mean_score = mean(MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_score = min(MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_score = max(MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_score = sd(MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    median = quantile(MAVE_Score, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1 = quantile(MAVE_Score, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3 = quantile(MAVE_Score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr = IQR(MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    Significant = sum(MAVE_Empirical_p_Value <= 0.05 & MAVE_Barcode_Count >= 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    Percent_Significant = ((Significant/ n ) * 100),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

# Plot MAVE Flow-Seq Scores for MDSGene Annotations: Genetic Classification and Clinical Severity 
```{r plotting- MDSGene genetic classification and clinical severity}
MDS_MissenseNonsense_Subset <- MDS_MissenseNonsense_Subset %>%
  mutate(
    MDS_n_bin = cut(
      MDS_n,
      breaks = c(0, 10, 25, 100, 500, 10000, Inf),
      labels = c(
        "1–10",
        "11–25",
        "26–100",
        "101–500",
        "501–10000",
        "10000+"
      ),
      right = TRUE,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  )


Annotated <- c("R502C", "G241R", "D448H", "L483P", "V414L", "V433L", "R159W", "S310G", 
               "H294Q", "R170S", "R329W", "V437L", "R324C", 
               "V499L", "N409S", "W417G", "V437I",  
               "E365K", "E427K", 
               "A495P", "N231K", "T408M", "R83C", "V391L", "P358L", "R324H", 
               "F285S", "Y352H", "D166E",
               "L25F") 


MDS_plot_df <- MDS_MissenseNonsense_Subset %>%
  mutate(
    Annotated = Variant %in% Annotated,
    
    nudge_x = case_when(
      #Pathogenic
      Variant == "H294Q" ~ 0.2,
      Variant == "R170S" ~ -0.25,
      Variant == "R502C" ~ -0.1,
      
      Variant == "D448H" ~ -0.4,
      Variant == "V414L" ~ -0.25,
      
      Variant == "L483P" ~  0.35,
      Variant == "G241R" ~  0.2,
      
      Variant == "V433L" ~ -0.2,
      Variant == "R159W" ~  -0.15,
      Variant == "V437L" ~ -0.05,
      Variant == "R324C" ~ 0.05,
      
      #Likely Pathogenic
      Variant == "S310G" ~ -0.25,
      Variant == "N409S" ~  0.35,
      Variant == "W417G" ~ -0.2,
      Variant == "V437I" ~ 0.1,
      Variant == "V499L" ~ 0.15,
      
      #VUS
      Variant == "T408M" ~ -0.35,
      Variant == "N231K" ~ -0.2,
      
      Variant == "R83C" ~ -0.25,
      Variant == "E427K" ~ 0.25,
      Variant == "A495P" ~ -0.1,
      
      Variant == "V391L" ~ -0.35,
      Variant == "D166E" ~ -0.1,
      Variant == "P358L" ~ 0.1,
      Variant == "R324H" ~  0.05,
      Variant == "Y352H" ~ -0.1,
      Variant == "F285S" ~ -0.05,
      
      Variant == "L25F" ~ 0.1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    
    x_nudged_genclass =
      as.numeric(MDSGene_Genetic_Classification) + nudge_x,
    x_nudged_clinsev = as.numeric(factor(
      MDSGene_Clinical_Severity,
      levels = c(
        "Severe",
        "Severe (Null)",
        "Mild",
        "PD Risk Variant",
        "Unknown",
        "Not Reported"
      )
    )) + nudge_x
    
  )



n_labels <- MDS_plot_df %>%
  group_by(MDSGene_Genetic_Classification) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(y_top = 0.3)


#Genetic classificaiton plotting
genclass_cols <- c(
  "Pathogenic" = "#C62828",
  "Likely Pathogenic" = "#F9A825",
  "Benign" = "#1565C0",
  "Likely Benign" = "#4FC3F7",
  "VUS" = "#7E57C2" 
)

max(MDS_plot_df$MAVE_Score)


MDS_GenClass_plot <- ggplot() +
  
  # --- Boxplot
  geom_boxplot(
    data = MDS_plot_df,
    aes(x = MDSGene_Genetic_Classification, y = MAVE_Score),
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    size = 0.1
  ) +
  
  # --- Non-annotated variants
  geom_quasirandom(
    data = MDS_plot_df %>% filter(!Annotated),
    aes(
      x = MDSGene_Genetic_Classification,
      y = MAVE_Score,
      colour = MDSGene_Genetic_Classification,
      shape = Barcode_Group
    ),
    width = 0.32,
    size = 0.65,
    alpha = 0.6,
    stroke = 0.1
  ) +
  
  # --- Annotated variants
  geom_point(
    data = MDS_plot_df %>% filter(Annotated),
    aes(
      x = x_nudged_genclass,
      y = MAVE_Score,
      colour = MDSGene_Genetic_Classification,
      fill = MDSGene_Genetic_Classification,
      size = MDS_n_bin,
      shape = Barcode_Group
    ),
    alpha = 0.6,
    stroke = 0.1
  ) +
  
  # --- Annotation lines
  geom_segment(
    data = MDS_plot_df %>% filter(Annotated),
    aes(
      x = x_nudged_genclass,
      xend = x_nudged_genclass + 0.15,
      y = MAVE_Score,
      yend = MAVE_Score + 0.08
    ),
    linewidth = 0.1,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  
  # --- Variant labels
  geom_text(
    data = MDS_plot_df %>% filter(Annotated),
    aes(
      x = x_nudged_genclass + 0.15,
      y = MAVE_Score + 0.08,
      label = Variant
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  # --- n labels
  geom_text(
    data = n_labels,
    aes(
      x = MDSGene_Genetic_Classification,
      y = y_top,
      label = paste0("n = ", n)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  # --- Point size legend
  scale_size_manual(
    name = "Case Count",
    values = c(
      "1–10" = 0.75,
      "11–25" = 1,
      "26–100" = 2,
      "101–500" = 3,
      "501–10000" = 4,
      "10000+" = 5
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "≥3 barcodes" = 16,
      "<3 barcodes" = 1
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  
  # STOP control median line
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = stop_median,
    colour = "darkred",
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.25
  )+
  
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    color = "darkgreen",
    alpha = 0.75,
    linewidth = 0.15,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  
  # --- Genetic classification colours
  scale_color_manual(values = genclass_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genclass_cols, guide = "none") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-1.25, 0.3),
    breaks = seq(-1.25, 0.25, by = 0.25)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "Pathogenic" = "Pathogenic",
      "Likely Pathogenic" = "Likely\nPathogenic",
      "Benign" = "Benign",
      "Likely Benign" = "Likely\nBenign",
      "VUS" = "VUS"
    )
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90",linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90",linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6,face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.05, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.02, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.margin = margin(0,0,0,0),
    legend.box.margin = margin(0,0,0,0),
    
    axis.title.x = element_text( size = 7, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text( size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text( size = 7),
    axis.title.y = element_text( size = 7, face = "bold" ),
    axis.ticks = element_line( colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1 ),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm")) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Genetic Classification",
    y = "Flow-Seq Score"
  ) +
  
  guides(
    size = guide_legend(
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(
        shape = 16,
        colour = "black",
        fill = "black",
        alpha = 1,
        stroke = 0
      )
    )
  )


print(MDS_GenClass_plot)

#Saving the file
ggsave("MDS GenClass.pdf", 
       device = cairo_pdf,
       width = 80,
       height = 80,
       units = "mm")
```

# Run Statistical Analysis of MAVE Flow-seq Scores by Clinical Severity Group
```{r Calculate Statistical Comparison between Clinical Severity Groups}
ClinSev_forStats <- MDS_plot_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(MDSGene_Clinical_Severity)) %>%
  mutate(
    Clinical_Severity_combined = case_when(
      MDSGene_Clinical_Severity %in% c("Severe", "Severe (Null)") ~ "Severe GD",
      TRUE ~ MDSGene_Clinical_Severity
    )
  ) 

ClinSev_forStats %>%
  filter(Clinical_Severity_combined == "Severe GD") %>%
  summarise(
    mean_MAVE = mean(MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

kruskal.test(MAVE_Score ~ Clinical_Severity_combined, data = ClinSev_forStats)

ClinSevStats <- ClinSev_forStats %>%
  dunn_test(
    MAVE_Score ~ Clinical_Severity_combined,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  )

```


# Generate Sankey Plot of MDSGene Annotated GBA1 Variants

```{R plotting- Sankey Plot Generation}
Sankey_df <- MDS_plot_df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(MDSGene_Genetic_Classification),
    !is.na(MDSGene_Clinical_Severity)
  ) %>%
  count(
    MDSGene_Genetic_Classification,
    MDSGene_Clinical_Severity,
    name = "Freq"
  )

Sankey_plot <- ggplot(
  Sankey_df,
  aes(
    axis1 = MDSGene_Genetic_Classification,
    axis2 = MDSGene_Clinical_Severity,
    y = Freq
  )
) +
  
  geom_alluvium(
    aes(fill = MDSGene_Genetic_Classification),
    alpha = 0.7,
    width = 0.005
  ) +
  
  geom_stratum(
    aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)),
    width = 0.05,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Pathogenic" = "#C62828",
      "Likely Pathogenic" = "#F9A825",
      "Benign" = "#1565C0",
      "Likely Benign" = "#4FC3F7",
      "VUS" = "#7E57C2",
      "Unknown" = "#5AAE9A",
      "Severe (Null)" = "#F28E5C",
      "Severe" = "#8FA3C7",
      "Mild" = "#D98ACB",
      "PD Risk Variant" = "#A6CE63",
      "Not Reported" = "grey70"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
    size = 4
  ) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c(
      "MDSGene_Genetic_Classification",
      "MDSGene_Clinical_Severity"
    )
  ) +
  
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Arial"))

print(Sankey_plot)

ggsave("Sankey_plot.pdf",
       device = cairo_pdf,
       plot = Sankey_plot, 
       width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300,
       bg = "transparent")

```


# Generate Volcano Plots of MAVE Flow-seq Scores for MDSGene-Annotated Variants

Generate two volcano plots:

1. MDSGene-annotated variants of uncertain significance against MAVE Flow-seq scores.
2. MDSGene-annotated pathogenic, likely pathogenic, benign, and likely benign variants against MAVE Flow-seq scores.

```{r plotting- Volcano Plot Generation}
AllVUSSubset <- MDS_MissenseNonsense_Subset %>%
  filter(MDSGene_Genetic_Classification == "VUS")

VUS_Volcano_plot <- ggplot(
  AllVUSSubset,
  aes(
    x = MAVE_Score,
    y = -log10(MAVE_Empirical_p_Value)
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = Barcode_Group),
    colour = "#7E57C2",   
    alpha = 0.5,
    size = 2,
    stroke = 0.1
  ) +
  
  geom_text_repel(
    data = AllVUSSubset %>% filter(Variant %in% Annotated),
    aes(label = Variant),
    size = 2,
    force = 8,
    box.padding = 0.8,
    point.padding = 0,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.color = "black",
    segment.size = 0.1,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "red",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    colour = "darkgreen",
    linetype = "solid",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "≥3 barcodes" = 16,
      "<3 barcodes" = 1
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) + 
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-1.25, 0.3),
    breaks = seq(-1.25, 0.25, by = 0.25)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4)) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Flow-Seq Score",
    y = expression(-log[10]("empirical p value"))
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line( color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line( color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8,face = "bold" ),
    axis.title.y = element_text( size = 8,face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text( size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.ticks = element_line( colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black",linewidth = 0.15)
  )

print(VUS_Volcano_plot)


ggsave("VUS_Volcano_plot.pdf",
       plot = VUS_Volcano_plot, 
       device = cairo_pdf,
       width = 85,
       height = 85,
       units = "mm")


#Volcano plot: pathogenic, likely pathogenic, benign, likely benign

AllPathogenicBenign_Subset <- MDS_MissenseNonsense_Subset %>%
  filter(MDSGene_Genetic_Classification %in% c("Pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Benign", "Likely Benign")) %>%
  mutate(Annotated = Variant %in% Annotated)

Pathogenic_Benign_Volcano_plot <- ggplot(
  AllPathogenicBenign_Subset,
  aes(
    x = MAVE_Score,
    y = -log10(MAVE_Empirical_p_Value),
    color = MDSGene_Genetic_Classification,
    shape = Barcode_Group
  )
) +
  
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.4,
    size = 2,
    stroke = 0.1  
  ) +
  
  geom_text_repel(
    data = AllPathogenicBenign_Subset %>% filter(Annotated),
    aes(label = Variant),
    size = 2,
    force = 8,
    box.padding = 0.8,
    point.padding = 0,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.color = "black",
    segment.size = 0.1,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    colour = "darkgreen",
    linewidth = 0.15
    
  ) +
  
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "red",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Genetic Classification",
    values = c(
      "Pathogenic" = "#C62828",
      "Likely Pathogenic" = "#F9A825",
      "Benign" = "#1565C0",
      "Likely Benign" = "#4FC3F7"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  
  scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(
        "≥3 barcodes" = 16,
        "<3 barcodes" = 1),   
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-1.25, 0.3),
    breaks = seq(-1.25, 0.25, by = 0.25)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4)) +
  labs(
    x = "Flow-Seq Score",
    y = expression(-log[10]("empirical p value"))
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line( color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line( color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    axis.title.x = element_text( size = 8,  face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text( size = 8, face = "bold"),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(  size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text( size = 8),
    
    axis.ticks = element_line( colour = "black",linewidth = 0.1),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black",linewidth = 0.15
    )
  )


print(Pathogenic_Benign_Volcano_plot)
```
